"""Run the original, never-started V138 production phase after dead admission."""
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def main():
    receipt = read(ROOT / "preflight-v1.json")
    original = receipt["original_plan"]
    assert ref(original["path"]) == original
    plan = read(original["path"])
    guard(plan)
    work = Path(plan["work"])
    oldroot = Path(plan["root"])
    assert ref(receipt["original_terminal_status"]["path"]) == receipt["original_terminal_status"]
    for binding in receipt["adopted_checks"]:
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
        assert not live(read(binding["path"])["owner"])
    dependency = read(receipt["unrelated_dependency_terminal_status"]["path"])
    prior = read(receipt["original_terminal_status"]["path"])
    for state in (dependency, prior):
        for key in ("controller", "child"):
            if state.get(key):
                assert not live(state[key])
    assert not (oldroot / "train-V138.claim").exists()
    assert not (oldroot / "train-V138-result.json").exists()
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    frozen = {"original_plan": original, "preflight": ref(ROOT / "preflight-v1.json"), "controller": ref(__file__), "adopted_checks": receipt["adopted_checks"], "phase": "train", "arm": "V138", "updates": 1000, "maximum_worker_seconds": plan["maximum_train_worker_seconds"], "reason": "Original V138 owner and unrelated V125 admission owner are terminal. V138 production claim/run/result are absent. Adopt passed original CPU/CUDA checks without replay; execute original worker/config once. Original failed status/plans/checkpoints remain unchanged.", "owner": owner}
    save(ROOT / "recovery-plan-v1.json", frozen)
    state = {"controller": owner, "recovery_plan": ref(ROOT / "recovery-plan-v1.json"), "status": "admitting-original-unstarted-production", "child": None}

    def record(status, **kwargs):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix_UTC=time.time(), **kwargs)
        temporary = ROOT / "status-v1.tmp"
        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2) + "\n")
        temporary.replace(ROOT / "status-v1.json")

    child = None
    try:
        record("admitting-original-unstarted-production")
        assert psutil.virtual_memory().available >= plan["launch_available_RAM_GiB"]*2**30
        assert shutil.disk_usage(oldroot).free >= plan["phase_start_internal_free_GiB"]*2**30
        assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free >= plan["phase_start_external_free_GiB"]*2**30
        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=f"{work/'src'}:{work/'scripts'}", CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0", HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1", TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1", OMP_NUM_THREADS="4", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1", CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8")
        with (oldroot / "train-V138.log").open("x") as log:
            child = subprocess.Popen([plan["python"], "-P", plan["worker_script"]["path"], "worker", original["path"], "--phase", "train", "--arm", "V138"], cwd=work, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, start_new_session=True)
            identity = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
            started = time.time()
            record("running-original-V138-production", child=identity, worker_started_unix_UTC=started, worker_deadline_unix_UTC=started+plan["maximum_train_worker_seconds"])
            while child.poll() is None:
                assert time.time() < started+plan["maximum_train_worker_seconds"]
                assert shutil.disk_usage(oldroot).free > plan["runtime_internal_reserve_GiB"]*2**30
                assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > plan["runtime_external_reserve_GiB"]*2**30
                record("running-original-V138-production")
                time.sleep(5)
            assert child.wait() == 0, child.returncode
        result = read(oldroot / "train-V138-result.json")
        assert result["status"] == plan["phase_result_status"] and result["updates"] == 1000
        assert result["optimizer_state_count"] == 18 and result["model_EMA_Adam_finite"]
        assert ref(result["checkpoint"]["path"]) == result["checkpoint"]
        guard(plan)
        assert ref(receipt["original_terminal_status"]["path"]) == receipt["original_terminal_status"]
        record("completed-original-production-awaiting-model-comparisons", result=ref(oldroot / "train-V138-result.json"), child_exit_code=0)
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None:
            child.terminate()
            try:
                child.wait(30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                child.kill()
                child.wait()
        record("failed-recovery-preserved-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error), child_exit_code=None if child is None else child.returncode)
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""One bounded endpoint/flat review after the exact recovered V138 owner exits."""
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def main():
    queue_path = ROOT / "queue-plan-v1.json"
    queue = read(queue_path)
    guard(queue)
    training_state = read(queue["training_recovery_status"])
    assert training_state["recovery_plan"] == queue["training_recovery_plan"]
    expected_owner = training_state["controller"]
    assert live(expected_owner)
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    limit = training_state["worker_deadline_unix_UTC"] + 6*3600
    save(ROOT / "watch-plan-v1.json", {"queue": ref(queue_path), "watcher": ref(__file__), "training_owner": expected_owner, "owner": owner, "absolute_deadline_unix_UTC": limit, "planned_new_root_DINO_forwards": 150, "new_noise_draws": 0, "RAW_decodes": 0, "scope": "Adopt frozen originalV138 endpoint protocol, plus48 retained analytic flats. Wait exact replacement training owner success and exit, validate actual1000/109EMA/18Adam/91frozenparent/all1000pairedinputs/67source, then102primary and48flat forwards once. Faint/JPEG/audits use cached outputs. Original failed plans/status/receipts remain untouched."})
    state = {"owner": owner, "plan": ref(ROOT / "watch-plan-v1.json"), "completed": {}, "child": None}

    def record(status, **kwargs):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix_UTC=time.time(), **kwargs)
        temp = ROOT / "pipeline-status-v1.tmp"
        temp.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2)+"\n")
        temp.replace(ROOT / "pipeline-status-v1.json")

    child = None
    child_owner = None

    def run(label, script, args, cuda=False, seconds=1800):
        nonlocal child, child_owner
        assert time.time() < limit
        guard(queue)
        work = Path(queue["work"])
        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=f"{work/'src'}:{work/'scripts'}", CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0" if cuda else "", HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1", TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1", OMP_NUM_THREADS="2", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1", CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8")
        with (ROOT / f"recovery-{label}.log").open("x") as log:
            child = subprocess.Popen([queue["python"], "-P", str(script), *map(str, args)], cwd=work, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, start_new_session=True)
            child_owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
            record("running-"+label, child=child_owner)
            began = time.monotonic()
            while child.poll() is None:
                assert time.monotonic()-began < seconds and time.time() < limit
                time.sleep(5)
            assert child.wait() == 0, (label, child.returncode)
        state["completed"][label] = True
        record("completed-"+label, child=None)

    try:
        while True:
            training_state = read(queue["training_recovery_status"])
            assert training_state["controller"] == expected_owner
            assert training_state["recovery_plan"] == queue["training_recovery_plan"]
            assert not training_state["status"].startswith("failed"), training_state
            if not live(expected_owner):
                assert training_state["status"] == "completed-original-production-awaiting-model-comparisons"
                assert not live(training_state["child"])
                break
            assert time.time() < limit
            record("waiting-for-exact-original-production-owner", training_owner=expected_owner)
            time.sleep(10)
        run("bind-endpoint", queue["endpoint_binder"]["path"], [queue_path])
        stable = None
        while True:
            enough = psutil.virtual_memory().available >= queue["launch_RAM_GiB"]*2**30
            stable = (time.monotonic() if stable is None else stable) if enough else None
            if stable is not None and time.monotonic()-stable >= 15:
                break
            assert time.time() < limit
            record("waiting-for-quality-resource-headroom", child=None)
            time.sleep(5)
        run("primary-faint-JPEG", queue["primary_runner"]["path"], [ROOT], True, 4*3600)
        assert read(ROOT / "collection-v1.json")["counts"] == {"root": 102, "encoder": 102}
        assert read(ROOT / "independent-audit-v1.json")["status"].startswith("passed")
        flat = ROOT / "flat-v1"
        run("flat-collect", queue["flat_operator"]["path"], ["collect", flat], True, 2400)
        run("flat-report", queue["flat_operator"]["path"], ["report", flat])
        run("flat-audit", queue["flat_auditor"]["path"], [flat])
        assert read(flat / "collection-v1.json")["counts"] == {"root": 48, "encoder": 48}
        assert read(flat / "independent-flat-audit-v1.json")["status"].startswith("passed")
        record("completed-150-input-review-awaiting-native-viewing", child=None)
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(child_owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGINT)
            try:
                child.wait(30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                child.wait(30)
        record("failed-review-recovery-preserved-no-automatic-retry", child=None, error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

def run(root):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    work = Path(plan["work"])
    env = dict(
        os.environ,
        PYTHONPATH=f"{work / 'src'}:{work / 'scripts'}",
        HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
        TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
        OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
        PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",
    )
    scripts = work / "scripts"
    stages = [
        (
            "collect",
            scripts / "collect_retained_checkpoint_pilot.py",
            [root / "plan-v1.json"],
            True,
        ),
        (
            "report",
            scripts / "report_checkpoint_pilot.py",
            [root / "plan-v1.json", root / "collection-v1.json"],
            False,
        ),
        ("audit", scripts / "audit_checkpoint_pilot.py", [root], False),
        (
            "faint-analyze",
            scripts / "analyze_retained_faint_detail.py",
            [root / "faint-analysis-plan-v1.json"],
            False,
        ),
        (
            "faint-audit",
            scripts / "audit_retained_faint_detail.py",
            [root / "faint-analysis-plan-v1.json"],
            False,
        ),
        ("camera-JPEG", root / "render-mesh-JPEG-v1.py", [], False),
    ]
    for label, script, args, cuda in stages:
        guard(plan)
        with (root / f"{label}.log").open("x") as log:
            subprocess.run(
                [plan["python"], "-P", str(script), *map(str, args)],
                cwd=work,
                env={**env, "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "0" if cuda else ""},
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                timeout=3600 if cuda else 1800,
                check=True,
            )
        print(label, "completed", flush=True)
        if label == "audit":
            # Compatibility with the existing faint-analysis stage contract:
            # all primary numeric/pixel checks are complete; viewing is pending.
            save(
                root / "status.json",
                {
                    "owner": None,
                    "status": plan.get(
                        "primary_complete_status",
                        "completed-global1000-review-awaiting-actual-native-viewing",
                    ),
                    "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
                    "primary_audit": ref(root / "independent-audit-v1.json"),
                    "scope": f"{plan['model_label']} primary stages completed by this runner; no dependency owner.",
                },
            )


run(Path(sys.argv[1]))

"""Independent source-group reductions of the completed V138 report."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def ref(path):
    p = Path(path).resolve()
    return {"path": str(p), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}


summary = json.loads((ROOT / "summary-v1.json").read_text())
report = json.loads(Path(summary["primary_report"]["path"]).read_text())
flat = json.loads(Path(summary["flat_report"]["path"]).read_text())
assert ref(summary["primary_report"]["path"]) == summary["primary_report"]
assert ref(summary["flat_report"]["path"]) == summary["flat_report"]
maximum, groups = 0., 0


def check(a, b):
    global maximum, groups
    difference = abs(float(a)-float(b))
    assert difference < 1e-12
    maximum = max(maximum, difference)
    groups += 1


for item in summary["primary"]:
    selected = []
    for row in report["metrics"]:
        case = row["case"]
        condition = "ordinary"
        if "contrast0p025" in case:
            condition = "faint-ADC"
        elif "gain1over8" in case or "gain1over32" in case:
            condition = "gain"+case.split("-gain", 1)[1].replace("-prior", "")
        if row["method"] == item["method"] and condition == item["stratum"]:
            selected.append(row["sRGB_PSNR"])
    assert len(selected) == 16
    check(np.mean(selected), item["mean_sRGB_PSNR"])
for item in summary["flats"]:
    selected = [r for r in flat["flat_metrics"] if r["method"] == item["method"] and r["case"]["condition"]["name"] == item["condition"]]
    assert len(selected) == 24
    check(np.mean([np.sqrt(r["spatial_MSE"])*65535 for r in selected]), item["mean_spatial_RMS_DN16"])
    check(np.mean([r["block_RMS"]["32"]*65535 for r in selected]), item["mean_block32_RMS_DN16"])
    check(max(abs(x)*65535 for r in selected for x in r["DC_RGB"]), item["maximum_absolute_DC_DN16"])
for item in summary["sky_descriptive"]:
    row = next(r for r in flat["sky_metrics"] if r["method"] == item["method"])
    check(row["detrended_variation"]["block_RMS"]["32"]*65535, item["block32_RMS_DN16"])
faint = json.loads((ROOT / "faint-detail-v1/result-v1.json").read_text())
for item in summary["faint_decomposition"]:
    selected = [r for r in faint["decomposition"] if r["method"] == item["method"] and r["space"] == item["space"]]
    assert len(selected) == 16
    for key in ("MSE", "DC_MSE", "spatial_MSE"):
        check(np.mean([r[key] for r in selected]), item[key])
output = {"status": "pass", "summary": ref(ROOT / "summary-v1.json"), "auditor": ref(__file__), "independent_group_reductions": groups, "maximum_difference": maximum, "new_model_forwards": 0, "new_noise_draws": 0}
with (ROOT / "summary-audit-v1.json").open("x") as f:
    json.dump(output, f, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(output))
